text.description_html:
Acorn PR5YP, Large Square Rose Ceramic Cabinet Knob

When everything seems like it is made by machine, Acorn offers ceramic cabinet knobs that are individually hand painted. The abstract rose of this cabinet knob will add a bit of whimsy to your home. The Hand Painted Large Square Rose Cabinet Knob is available in two colors, off white with an orange rose or green with a mauve rose. It has a 1-3/4 inch diameter.

Also Available:
Hand Painted Small Square Rose Cabinet Knob
Hand Painted Ceramic Square Rose Cabinet Pull

Features of the Large Square Rose Cabinet Knob:

  • Diameter: 1-3/4"
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
